Thanks Rishi - very helpful recap. A couple clarifying points from our security and legal teams:

1) Scope: AcmeHealth will be sending PHI in prompts for triage/triage-assist flows. We need guarantees around both prompt and output handling.
2) Retention/residency: for EU-based clinics we need data residency in EU for both requests and any logs / telemetry.
3) No-store: ideally we want request-level no-store for certain endpoints so nothing is persisted beyond ephemeral processing. If that's not available on hosted, we'd be interested in Dedicated/Private options and associated timelines/pricing.
4) Evidence: can you share SOC2/ISO summary and a short note on encryption/KMS? We'll feed this into our vendor risk assessment.

I'll attach our vendor security questionnaire in a follow-up email (attaching now). Also, procurement will want an initial estimate for Dedicated pricing and expected lead time.

Hi Will / Jared / Rishi -

Thanks for the clear list - I'm Neha from Security & Trust. Below is a concise summary addressing each of your points plus recommended configuration options for AcmeHealth's PHI use case. If helpful, we can run a 30-minute technical security review and walk through your questionnaire line-by-line.

1) Default hosted (Redwood cloud):
   - What is stored: by default, for abuse detection, model quality, and operational debugging we retain request metadata and the full prompt + generated output for a configurable short retention window.
   - Retention window: default 30 days for hosted API customers (rolling). After that data is purged from our active systems; some operational logs may be retained longer in aggregated/anonymized form for telemetry (no PII).
   - Access: only our SRE/security team with documented role-based access can access logs; access is audited.

2) No-store / request-level control:
   - Hosted: we support a request-level header (x-redwood-no-store) on enterprise-hosted plans that prevents persistence of prompts and outputs. This header disables storage for model inputs/outputs but still emits minimal telemetry (request id, timestamp) for billing and rate limiting.
   - Dedicated / Private: for Dedicated capacity and Private deployments, customers can operate with a stronger no-store policy (no prompt/output persistence) and bring-your-own-key (BYOK) KMS so logs are encrypted under customer keys.

3) Data residency:
   - Hosted: we offer region-specific endpoints (us-west, us-east, eu-west). For EU residency we store data and logs within the EU region for requests routed to eu-west.
   - Dedicated / Private: can be deployed into customer VPCs or cloud accounts in EU or specific US regions to meet strict residency requirements.

4) Retention configurability & redaction:
   - Retention is configurable for Dedicated and Private deployments (zero retention options available). For hosted customers we can contractually reduce retention below the 30-day default on enterprise plans.
   - Redaction tooling: we offer token-level redaction and pre-processing hooks (customer-managed) to remove or mask PHI before sending to the model. We also provide guidance and sample libraries for client-side redaction.

5) Encryption & KMS:
   - Data at rest and in transit is encrypted. For Dedicated/Private we support BYOK integrations with AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, and Azure Key Vault. For hosted customers we use vendor-managed KMS but can discuss customer-specific arrangements on enterprise contracts.

6) Audit & compliance evidence:
   - We are SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified - summary and evidence attached (SOC2-summary-2026.pdf).
   - We also provide an audit log feed for Dedicated/Private customers and can support periodic access reviews for auditors.

7) Practical recommendations for AcmeHealth (PHI use case):
   - Short term (hosted): use enterprise-hosted endpoints with x-redwood-no-store header for PHI flows and configure token-level redaction client-side for highest safety.
   - Mid term (production, higher SLA / residency): plan for a Dedicated deployment in your target region (EU clusters for EU clinics). Dedicated gives you configurable retention, BYOK, and dedicated capacity for cost predictability.
   - We can provide a security addendum and contract language to reflect retention/residency commitments.

Next steps I propose:
- Rishi to schedule a 30-minute security sync with your security and procurement teams (I'll join).
- We'll share a redlined security addendum and a Dedicated pricing estimate (Marissa will follow up).

Happy to expand on any of the bullets above - let me know if you want a diagram update or additional artifacts.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
